chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 554: The Evergreen Sword Immortal's Betrayal and the Three-Eyed Fiendgod
chapter_meta_description: The Evergreen Sword Immortal reveals his true colors, killing his junior sister and crippling the defensive line. Ji Ning goes all-out but is crushed by the Three-Eyed Fiendgod. He must call upon the gods of the Starseizing Mansion.
og_title: Desolate Era 554: A Betrayal That Shakes the Heavens
og_description: Daofather Crimsonbright is forced to abandon a battlefront as his most trusted disciple turns traitor. Ji Ning unleashes his hidden heartforce power but meets an unstoppable enemy.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 554: The knife twist and the power gap
twitter_description: The Evergreen Sword Immortal's betrayal cuts deep. Ji Ning goes berserk, but even his new strength isn't enough. Time to wake the ancient gods.

lore_anchors.definition: A colossal battle avatar formed from coordinated immortal cultivator formations, representing the concentrated might of hundreds of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals.
A dragon-shaped war formation composed of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals, capable of devastating coordinated attacks.
Battle puppets formed by Celestial Immortals dissolving their formation and reassembling into smaller, individually more powerful combat units.
A condensed fragment of a True God Daofather's personal comprehension of Chaos, permanently sacrificed to grant a cultivator a temporary burst of Daofather-threshold power.
The fused combat form of the three Devouring Mountain Demon Gods, created through a unity formation, multiplying their power to the Daofather threshold.
One of the supreme archers of the Three Realms, a Heartforce master at the fourth level of perfection, whose arrows can strike fear into any Heavenly God or True Immortal.
A legendary Xianxia tactic where multiple powerful beings merge their Dao-hearts, divine power, and soul energy into a single gestalt entity of vastly greater power.

A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power. It is the foundation of arts like archery and is stronger when the user possesses a heart of absolute sincerity.
A Celestial Immortal who has perfected the five elemental Daos and transformed their golden core to Pure Yang, gaining vastly increased power and durability.
The ruler of the Grand Xia Dynasty and a major commander in the Crimsonbright Realm's defensive forces; a True Immortal-level combatant.
The supreme leader of the Crimsonbright Realm, an ancient True God Daofather who survived the Dawn War and commands the overall strategy against the Seamless Gate.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Daofather Crimsonbright abandon Ji Ning's area?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He had to make a strategic trade-off. Dongzhe's Chaos Daofruit arrows were limited; supporting Ji Ning's area would only slow the loss, while using them elsewhere could secure victories on seven other fronts.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did the Evergreen Sword Immortal hide his betrayal for so long?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His Dao-heart was immaculate—he was a true, single-minded Dao-seeker, which made him appear utterly trustworthy. The best traitor is one who never doubts themselves, even for an instant.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why couldn't Ji Ning beat the Three-Eyed Fiendgod?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Three-Eyed Fiendgod's power crossed the Daofather threshold. A Daofather-level enemy is an entirely different tier of existence; Ji Ning, despite his heartforce boost, is still an Empyrean God, and the gap between those realms is enormous.
